propositions: The unread baseline_advanced_at stamp is deleted so it is no longer written by set_baseline, eliminating scattered per-version edits that bloat git delta compression.
set_baseline gains a compare-and-return-early guard that skips writing when the filtered baseline is unchanged.
Two consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state must produce a byte-identical bindings.json and create no commit.
A baseline field present-but-null must round-trip as present to preserve the `if k in fields` local-wins semantics.
A changed baseline value (A to B) must still persist and change the saved bytes, ensuring the guard never degenerates into never-write.
Marginal packed cost per changed bindings.json version must drop to at most 25% of the measured baseline across 40 consecutive revisions.
